@gcankara Hi GKNCY 👋 

That's a good question!

In order to stake a token, it must be based on Proof-of-Stake (PoS) protocol. 
Dogecoin is based on Proof-of-Work (PoW) protocol which means it can't be staked to earn rewards. 

🐙  You can read more about it here: https://t.co/Kamv3KWTXt
